lines: Ow, ow, ow. Okay, that one was my fault, sorry.
Hey, don't you dare leave me alone down here with the dust.
I think I cracked a rib. Great, my favorite kind of day.
My shoulder's screaming. Please tell it to shut up.
I'm bleeding all over the floor, which is honestly rude of me.
Stay with me, okay? I'm really bad at being alone right now.
Talk to me. Anything. Tell me about your dumb cat.
I'm freezing. Give me your jacket, I won't tell anyone.
My hands won't stop shaking. Look at them, they're useless.
You're doing great. Honestly better than me, and I'm the one bleeding.
Is that flashlight flickering again? Stupid cranky thing.
Hey, look at me, not at the blood. Look at my stupid face.
I'm scared, okay? I don't want to say it, but I am.
If I pass out, yell at me. Loudly. That's an order.
Where's the revive kit? Please tell me you didn't drop it.
I'm not dying on a staircase. That's embarrassing for both of us.
Don't be nice to me, it makes me want to cry, and crying hurts.
My mouth tastes like pennies. Anybody got gum?
I'd sell a kidney for a cold can of soda right now.
Don't laugh. Okay, fine, laugh. It's a little funny.
Tell me a bad joke. The worse the better, I need a distraction.
I've got a crush on the granola bar. Don't eat it.
Please tell me the others got out the back door.
Don't carry me like a sack of groceries, I'm not a sack of groceries.
My legs are asleep, and I don't think they're waking up.
I'm so tired. Can we sit here for just one minute?
Okay, I'm breathing. In, out. That's the whole plan right now.
Keep counting with me. One, two, three, come on.
I'm not mad you ran. I'd have run too, honestly.
You're not leaving, right? Say it, even if you're lying.
My sister's going to yell at me for getting hurt again.
I promised Mom I'd be home for dinner. Lame, I know.
I'm trying to be brave, but it's hard with my side open.
My ankle's bent the wrong way. Don't look at it, please.
Please don't put me down on the wet part of the floor.
The pain comes in waves. Hold on, here's another one.
That last wave was worse. Don't tell me it's fine.
I hate this. I hate that you have to see me like this.
You've got dust all over your face. It's kind of cute, honestly.
I'll give you my last cookie if you get me out of here.
I should've taken the shortcut. Bad call. Really bad call.
Can you check if the bleeding's slowing? I can't see past my shoulder.
Hey, I know you're scared too. Talk to me anyway.
I'm not going to pass out on you. Probably. Maybe not.
If something comes around that corner, I'm throwing my shoe at it.
My hair's stuck to my forehead. Gross, but I'm too weak to fix it.
Stop apologizing. You didn't do this to me, the stairs did.
Why is it always the stairs? Always the stupid stairs.
I lost my glasses somewhere. Everything's a smear. Where are you?
My bag's by my knee. Grab the orange bandage, the big one.
Hold this on my side. Tighter. That's it. Thanks, that helps.
I'm not gonna cry. Okay, I'm gonna cry a little.
The room's spinning. Don't let go of my hand, okay?
I keep hearing things. It's just my nerves, right?
Okay, rule one: we don't split up again. Rule two: see rule one.
If I die, I'm haunting you, and you're going to hate it.
Ha. Don't make me laugh, my ribs are furious with me.
Who picked this route anyway? Terrible route. Worst route ever.
Honestly, I'd be fine if this floor would stop tilting.
My knee's locked. I can't walk, so you'll have to carry me.
Don't look at the blood. Please look at me instead.
Are you still there? Say something, anything, I'm begging.
I miss my lumpy old bed. I'd crawl back there right now.
You were my favorite person to run with, you know that?
Don't tell the others I cried. Blame the dust.
I refuse to die on this lousy carpet. It's ugly.
Cold water would be nice. Or a hug. Either one, honestly.
Point that flashlight at the wall, it's giving me a headache.
I'm listening. Keep going, you're doing great, keep going.
If we make it out, first round of drinks is on me.
I don't want to slow you down. Still, please stay with me.
Tell me one good thing. Anything. I'll wait right here.
Please don't let go of my hand. I'm holding on too.
Okay, I'm done being brave today. Can you take over for a bit?
Stay close. I'll be annoying, but at least I'll be alive.
